value.rationale: Whether improving unilateral Nash moves actually converge is a structural question that is not settled by existence of stable partitions. The strict aggregation contrast is sharp at order four; the exact 16/64 graph classification and first connected-tree obstruction at five vertices identify a natural boundary with persistence on all larger tree sizes. These are motivated dynamics results rather than arbitrary finite slices.
